table: GoldRespecPrices, CurrencyExchange, UniqueGoldPrices, SkillGemGoldPricePerLevel, SkillGemGoldPricePerQuality, GameConstants
note: Gold, as the game’s own tables give it. respec.levels[0] is character level 1: the gold to refund one passive point. exchange: the fee to buy one of an item on the Currency Exchange, by item name, for the items that have a card; tab is the Exchange tab it sits under, standard that Standard trades it too. unique: a unique’s gold price. gem: by level (levels[0] is level 1), by quality (quality[0] is 0%), and the flat price of a support and a lineage support.
